acceptance.rationale: Fixed upholstered sofa with three seats and arms; no adjustable or removable mechanism is represented. No cushion deformation, occupant animation or load certification.

Backrest rotates 0.50 rad rearward and footrest rotates 90 degrees forward about distinct X hinges. Two coordinated endpoint poses; fixed seat, arms and feet. No powered actuation, continuous linkage or occupant simulation. Reserve rear and front clearance.
Rigid low table with a continuous top and lower shelf; no height or folding mechanism. Distinct from service-height and office tables.
Cushioned lid rotates 90 degrees around rear X hinge to expose storage floor. No loose cushion removal masquerading as operation. Two poses, no damping or load rating.

One door travels 0.78 m between two bays within cabinet width. Cable recess is illustrative; no cable routing, automatic child attachments or audio system. Different from office drawer credenza and tall utility cabinet.
Electrical on/off is represented by bulb material emission. Shade, stem and base remain fixed. No cast illumination, shadows, mains simulation or articulated shade.
Display power toggles between blank screen and an original static test image. Not video playback, broadcast reception or audio. Feet rest on a certified console surface at unit scale; no wall mount.

Three connected leaves pivot about vertical hinge axes on a fixed weighted stand. Endpoint spreads change partition width without relocating the base. No freestanding balance or hinge collision simulation; endpoint clearance is included.
Rigid coat stand for reception or lounge entry. No folding, height mechanism or cloth attachment. Branches are not certified flat support surfaces; distinct from utility drip-tray tool stand.

One authored two-table assembly, counted once; neither constituent is separately registered. Smaller whole table translates 0.56 m to provide a second surface, rather than a cosmetic part toggle. Fixed endpoint poses; loose items do not follow table movement.
